smartDecision.reason: D31 showed that broad Tell-Me searches for VAT Setup and Manual Setup can leave only a search overlay. Microsoft Learn points to Assisted Setup and the concrete manual VAT setup pages.
sourceSupport: Microsoft Learn: open Assisted Setup and choose Set up Value-Added Tax (VAT).

smartDecision.fallback: Keep VAT setup writes parked and use the observed direct page route for a separate write-gate decision.
smartDecision.beginnerBookUse: Explain that VAT setup consists of business groups, product groups and the posting matrix before any sales or purchase document can post VAT.
